product.name: Risograph Printing Service
product.description: A stencil printing service using spot colors and soy inks to produce tactile, vibrant prints with low environmental impact.

product.name: Print Your Own Service
product.description: A service allowing customers to upload their artwork and order custom Risograph prints with selectable paper types, quantities, and finishing options.

product.name: Riso Club Print Subscription
product.description: A monthly subscription service delivering curated Risograph prints and print-related items to members.

product.name: Blank Paper Sales
product.description: Sales of blank A3 sheets and custom-cut paper for use in Risograph printing or other creative projects.

product.name: Print Tutorials and Guides
product.description: Educational resources including tutorials, FAQs, and how-to guides on preparing artwork and using Risograph printing techniques.
